newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-SALOMON KEEPS MUNICH HOLD.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-SALOMON KEEPS MUNICH HOLD.

text.p: Stockbroker Salomon Brothers said it is keeping its recommendation on reinsurer Munich Re at hold pending clarification of the group's future strategy.

"Following the ERGO deal and the market's favourable reception of Bayerische Vereinsbank's purchase of Hypobank, interest will focus on whether further restructuring potential exists at Munich Re," Salomon said in a research note.
On the surface, the ERGO deal -- which gives Munich Re control of a large primary insurer -- was sensible, but raises several important strategic questions, the broker said.
Salomon said Munich Re could reduce excess capital and unwind cross-holdings, "However, we doubt that management will act on this potential."
Munich Re shares, currently trading at 6,630 marks, do not look particularly expensive, Salomon said, and has raised its price target to 7,050 marks.
